title: MONUMENT:
text:
MONUMENT:  FOX VILLAGE THEATRE, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #362

  Plan Area: Westwood  Council District: 5 – Yaroslavsky

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  945 – 961 South Broxton Avenue; 10955 West Weyburn Avenue

  Informational presentation on the proposed rehabilitation project. Commission review and comment.

  Owner:  Village Directors Circle LLC

  Presenters:  Jason Reitman, Owner’s Representative; John LoCascio, Historic Resources Group;
  Wayne Thomas, Gensler
summary: The Cultural Heritage Commission will hear an informational presentation on a proposed rehabilitation of the Fox Village Theatre, a historic-cultural monument in Westwood, and will comment on it.

locations.text: 945 S Broxton Ave, Los Angeles, CA
